pages.observations: Bayes equation, positive denominator and prior/posterior distinction.
LIFO/depth/backtracking definition; no claim that the different road-graph exercise reproduces this red trace.
Local tip-velocity components precede the explicit coordinate map on the following page; new family uses supplied components rather than re-deriving this recursion.
Explicit Rz(theta1+theta2) rotation and velocity-coordinate map.
Net external force equals mass times center-of-mass acceleration.
Parallel stiffness sum and series reciprocal-stiffness sum.
Matrix inertia plus V and G; prose also mentions friction.
Explicit additional F friction/non-rigid effects; generated inertia task sets V,G,F to zero.
Full TD update with pre-update old value, learning rate eta and max bootstrap.
Epsilon exploration branch; uniform-all-actions convention is explicit in new premise, not inferred from prose alone.
Source bootstraps before terminated/truncated check; new true-terminal zero-bootstrap convention remains visibly qualified.
Repeated Q-learning summary; source convergence/global optimality prose is not imported as an unconditional guarantee of the finite generated examples.
Positive virtual-plane x=fX/Z and y=fY/Z, camera-frame inputs.
Floor output formula, per-side padding, stride; 28 to 24 source example.
Four- and eight-connected edges with cardinal1 and diagonal sqrt2 costs.
